subject: A river is a place we look after together
preheader: Join a spring workday or help put useful kit in our hands.

content.text:
A river is a place
we look after together.
The paths beside our river hold a lot of ordinary, lovely moments: a walk before work, a child spotting a beetle, a quiet ten minutes on a bench.
This spring, we’re making room for more of them. We’re bringing neighbours together to clear litter, plant the riverbank and care for the water on our doorstep.
Will you help us get the next stretch ready?

attrs.alt: Clear water flowing between rounded rocks beneath a green woodland canopy.

content.text: Two ways to lend a hand.
Give a little time, help cover the kit, or do both. Every workday starts with a friendly briefing.
Bring sturdy shoes and a water bottle. We’ll bring gloves, bags and a warm welcome.

Put useful kit
in our hands.
A gift helps us buy the small things that make a workday possible.
Our spring appeal is for practical workday supplies, native planting and tools we can keep using. The amounts above show example uses; gifts support the project as a whole.
You’ll hear how the season unfolds.
After each workday, we’ll send supporters a short field note with what we worked on and what comes next. You can also read the project plan before you give.

A river is a place we look after together.

 

Dear neighbour,

 

The paths beside our river hold a lot of ordinary, lovely moments: a walk before work, a child spotting a beetle, a quiet ten minutes on a bench.

 

This spring, we’re making room for more of them. We’re bringing neighbours together to clear litter, plant the riverbank and care for the water on our doorstep.

 

Will you help us get the next stretch ready?

 

Maya Ellis

Community coordinator

A moment beside the water

Give a little time, help cover the kit, or do both. Every workday starts with a friendly briefing.
